title: Pump Control in MDI bug upload data Treatment in Nightscout - openaps://AndroidAPS
body: Using the Pump Control 3.0.0.1 version, in MDI, AndroidAPS creates a new Treatment input for each received reading (from xdrip) with the following description Using the Pump Control 3.0.0.1 version, in MDI, AndroidAPS creates a new Treatment input for each received reading (from xdrip) with the following description **openaps://AndroidAPS** + *Profile Name in cell phone* for each new reading received.
